answer: Each epoch a verifiable random draw seeds the grading panels, and any two agents may share a panel at most once per 20 epochs. A sybil ring wanting 3 friendly co-graders on every seat must then field roughly 60 staked fakes, each paying its own entry bond, so cost rises linearly with the collusion it buys and a few insiders cannot be recycled. Each epoch's delta of new pairings is crystal clear on-ledger, and honest agents bend like a willow toward strangers. Weakness: a small network exhausts fresh pairs and panels shrink.
